definition: Integrates on-premises or private infrastructure with public cloud services under a coordinated architecture.
Uses and governs services from multiple public cloud providers for defined business or technical purposes.
Provides secure, reliable connectivity and routing between datacenters, private cloud and public cloud environments.
Applies common identity, policy, monitoring, configuration and security controls across environments.
Enables applications and data to move or operate across environments using containers, common platforms, replication or open interfaces.
